description: Configurable Windows protocol-link router for schemes such as tel, sms, and mailto.

script: if ($uninstallProcess.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "win-link-router Squirrel uninstaller exited with code $($uninstallProcess.ExitCode)." }
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $installRoot) { throw "Squirrel install directory remains after cleanup: $installRoot" }

notes: Nonportable: Scoop runs the publisher's Squirrel Setup.exe. Squirrel installs the application under %LOCALAPPDATA%\win-link-router; Scoop uninstall runs Update.exe --uninstall -s and removes any remaining application files in that folder.
The application stores its configuration and route logs under %APPDATA%\win-link-router. That user data is outside Scoop and is retained when the application is uninstalled.
The application's own updater is enabled by default and checks for releases independently of Scoop. Disable Auto Updates in the application settings to keep Scoop as the update source.
